scope: Local synthetic-data portfolio verification; not a production deployment

http_smoke.server: Real Uvicorn HTTP process, isolated temporary SQLite database

meaningful_test_cases: Twenty simultaneous dispatches from a balance of nine commit exactly nine movements and reject eleven; final stock is zero
Eight simultaneous identical movement retries commit once
Eight simultaneous approved-request receipts commit once
An injected audit-write failure rolls back stock and movement
An injected receipt audit failure rolls back request, stock and movement
Restarting the application preserves state without reseeding
visual_browser_qa: Not performed; frontend build and served asset checks do not establish visual layout quality
limitations: Demo role headers are not authentication
Creating a replenishment request is not idempotent
